component.name: Cosmic Tailscale
component.summary: Manage Tailscale from the COSMIC panel

description.p: A COSMIC panel applet for managing an existing Tailscale installation. View connection state, connect or disconnect, change accounts and exit nodes, and send or receive files with Taildrop.
The native package uses the host Tailscale CLI. The Flatpak bundles the CLI and connects to the host tailscaled socket; it does not install or start the daemon.
